name: k-Ary and Gated Expansion
definition: Given a graph $G$ and a pairwise-intersecting cover $W_1,\ldots,W_k$ with no edges between opposite exclusive parts and the required isometric cover subgraphs, replace each vertex $x$ by the clique of copies $x_i$ for which $x\in W_i$, retaining the edges inside each copy. The expansion is gated when all pairwise intersections equal one set $U$ and every $G[W_i]$ and $G[U]$ is gated in $G$.
comments: For $k=2$ the construction specializes to binary graph expansion. Gated expansion also constrains every cover member and may create triangles, so it is broader than the partial-cube expansion hierarchy.
